title: Self-Made Millionaire Says Buying GTA 6 Saves You $5,000
description: British self-made millionaire Mark Tilbury claims that buying GTA 6 is the most sound financial advice of 2026 and will save you thousands.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Most Sound Financial Advice of 2026? Buy GTA 6

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the launch of Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, opinions on how to approach the title are coming from all corners of the internet. Recently, British self-made millionaire, entrepreneur, and social media educator Mark Tilbury dropped a video that caught the attention of both gamers and financial enthusiasts alike, offering what he calls the most sound financial advice of 2026: buy GTA 6.

According to reports from IGN Games, Tilbury argues that picking up the highly anticipated open-world title will actually save you a big chunk of change. While the source material keeps the precise breakdown under wraps, the underlying concept taps into a well-known theory among gamers: high-value entertainment can significantly curb other, much more expensive real-world habits.

## Breaking Down the Gaming Budget

For a massive title like GTA 6, players often sink hundreds of hours into the virtual world of Vice City and beyond. When looking at cost-per-hour entertainment, purchasing a single-purchase AAA game can easily rival or beat out the expenses racked up by frequent weekend outings, dining, and other costly leisure activities. 

Whether Tilbury's specific math translates directly to everyone's wallet remains to be seen, but the core sentiment resonates with anyone who has used a sprawling video game to stay indoors and save a bit of cash over the weekend.

## Editor's Take
While Mark Tilbury's take is undoubtedly a fun spin on personal finance, it highlights the immense value that a massive blockbuster game can bring to a player's entertainment budget. Trading a few costly nights out for hundreds of hours of gaming might just be the ultimate budget hack.
